opengwasr

The R client for OpenGWAS data. It queries Analyses, Associations, top hits and LD either through the OpenGWAS API or from Store Releases downloaded to your own machine, and replaces ieugwasr and gwasvcf as the data-access layer for TwoSampleMR.

Status: design. In development: the package skeleton and its checks are in place, and no query functions exist yet. The vocabulary is in GLOSSARY.md and the decisions so far are in docs/adr/.
